set.body:
Parked on 19 November 2026 (docs/plan.md).

EEG, MEG and eye-tracking recordings do not live in XNAT, and most legacy recordings are not in BIDS. For the MVP they arrive already in BIDS, or as an archive deposit. A conversion kit beside tools/xnat2bids, built on an existing converter such as mne-bids, would let a lab bring a legacy recording study in the way the Bring in journey brings MRI in. Bring this forward when a pilot lab has such a study.
set.title: LATER: EEG and MEG to BIDS conversion kit
